// why: Shared compiler options for every bundle's scripts.
Scripts run through `#!/usr/bin/env -S mise exec -- bun run --install=fallback`,
so they are never compiled. This config exists only so editors and a manual
`tsc --noEmit` understand Bun globals, node: imports and .ts import specifiers.
Each bundle extends this from its own tsconfig.json, because each bundle is
its own package with its own node_modules.
